newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 17 to 19 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 17 to 19 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 17 and 19 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on December 19, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the 4.50 percent October 1998 BTAN with a payment date of January 6, 1997, and the 5.50 percent October 2001 BTAN with a payment date of January 13, the statement said.
